name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement a Loschmidt echo
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 5 qubits with 5 layers of random rotations U, apply U^dagger, and verify the system returns to |0...0> with probability 1; then perturb one angle by 0.23 and report the echo decay. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
